title: The relaxed front-of-flow document requirements are scoped to FDIC-insured accounts
statement: Making the Wolfsberg questionnaire optional — and the wider removal of the friction points at the front of the flow — is limited to FDIC-insured accounts. Joel Olivares attaches the limit to the relaxation itself, and separately gives FDIC accounts as the reason he expects most residual risk reviews to be straightforward.

evidence.excerpt: Of course, this is only going to be for FDIC accounts.
I doubt that that will be the case because most of it will be straightforward, especially with the FDIC Accounts.
